subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should this large lineage subsystem land now as a legacy-default shadow path despite its remaining daily error and long-term maintenance cost?
rationale: The patch is intentionally reversible and presents substantial real-corpus evidence, but accepting a parallel central accounting architecture and its future promotion boundary is a repository ownership decision rather than a mechanical correctness determination.

options.title: Land shadow-only after prerequisite
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2157 first, then merge this branch with legacy authority and rollback unchanged while collecting broader validation.

options.title: Narrow to validation tooling
options.body: Retain the replay, diagnostics, and safe performance instrumentation while deferring the alternate accounting selector and production integration.

options.title: Pause the lineage architecture
options.body: Decline the maintenance surface and pursue a smaller containment fix within the current scanner instead.

recommendation.title: Land shadow-only after prerequisite
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2157 first, then merge this branch with legacy authority and rollback unchanged while collecting broader validation.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and release signer, `steipete` is the strongest available owner for deciding whether this central accounting architecture belongs in the project.
